title: Assessing the Political Fairness of Multilingual LLMs: A Case Study based on a 21-way Multiparallel EuroParl Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the machine translation quality (evaluated via sBLEU and COMET metrics) of European Parliament speeches across different EU political parties, and aggregating the rankings using Borda counts to identify systematic performance disparities.

Evaluating disparities in translation performance (sBLEU and COMET scores) across 21 different source and target languages, ranking them via Borda counts to determine which languages are systematically translated better or worse.
